mcp_operation_unsupported.description: actinglab-mcp lists this tool, the tool of an operation table row, but this build serves no call of it: the call was refused before anything was sent, run or written; mcp_tool names the tool.
mcp_operation_unsupported.common_causes: A call of a tool whose row this build does not serve yet: since Workflow #434 LAB-5G2b it serves the rows actinglab's CLI module serves, and refuses the three app rows and standard-pack check, the debugging and authoring rows actinglab's own commands serve, record draft and the rescue module's rows; the later slices of LAB-5 serve them.
mcp_operation_unsupported.handling: Run the operation with actinglab (actinglab --json and the row's words), or through actingctl mcp-serve, until a build of actinglab-mcp that serves the tool is installed; sending the same call again answers the same.
